**Issue #3567 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3567: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S19, the legends and rule benders
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the set's legends and rule benders: Profe Yates, Churnwalker, Snom Bunny, Soul Read, Bogos Binted and Doomed Ship.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #4 | Profe Yates |
| #7 | Churnwalker |
| #25 | Snom Bunny |
| #31 | Soul Read |
| #84 | Bogos Binted |
| #98 | Doomed Ship |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E6 (#3550): the secret pick, take control, the board snapshot.
- E7 (#3554): damage chains.
- E8 (#3558): hand positions and "when they meet".

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #4 Profe Yates: the exile hits every card in both hands, decks, graveyards and fields whose name holds any of M, O, U, S, E (any case), except CN cards and Yates itself. The two random Traps (Radiant: three Radiant Traps) are summoned face down into its owner's backrow. Its owner then chooses one of the three Activates, which Yates keeps. Wolf's Maw: the Flying Unit loses Flying and takes 4. Iron Mandate fuses Yates into a friendly Unit without running its Cry again. The voice lines are S26's.
- #7 Churnwalker: damage chains as E7 reads them. The Radiant face's Cry is the same choice (SP5).
- #25 Snom Bunny: a new card, not the shipped Snom Bunny Mind Control. Its Death takes control of a random enemy permanent (E6).
- #31 Soul Read: E6's secret pick. Only its owner ever sees the opponent's hand, and only during the pick.
- #84 Bogos Binted: E6's snapshot and restore.
- #98 Doomed Ship: one of the three pairs at random. "Kwzki" is iKwzki (S #110). The first card goes leftmost and the second rightmost, and when they meet (become adjacent) both become Radiant (Radiant face: and cost (0)).

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(4) Profe Yates, Unit, Catalyst, Acclaimed, Human, Felinor, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #4**
7/7
**Cry**: Exile every card with a M, O, U, S, E in its name *{cards in CN are immune}* then summon two random **traps** then choose one of the following **Activates:**

- Activate 1: Overwhelm: Freeze all units in this lane & surrounding lanes
- Activate 3: Wolf’s Maw: Pull a flying unit down *{it loses flying}*, and deal 4 damage to it
- Activate 1: Iron Mandate: Fuse this into a unit, *{does not trigger this cry again}*

*{Spawn voiceline: Every pack needs an alpha I don't see anyone else stepping up}*
*{Attack voiceline: a mouse once bit my sister}*
*{Death voiceline: I will not see the Northern Lights again}*
~~~
14/14
**Cry**: Exile every card with a M, O, U, S, E in its name *{cards in CN are immune}* then summon three random **Radiant** **traps** hen choose one of the following **Activates:**

- Activate 1: Overwhelm: Freeze all units in this lane & surrounding lanes
- Activate 3: Wolf’s Maw: Pull a flying unit down *{it loses flying}*, and deal 4 damage to it
- Activate 1: Iron Mandate: Fuse this into a unit, *{does not trigger this cry again}*

**(4) Churnwalker, Unit, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #7**
3/15
**Armor 4**
**Cry:** Choose one

- Chain all enemy units together, when one takes damage all other chained units also take the damage
- Chain all friendly units together, when one takes damage it is split between all allies (rounded down)

~~~
6/30
**Armor 8**
**Cry:**

- Chain all enemy units together, when one takes damage all other chained units also take the damage
- Chain all friendly units together, when one takes damage it is split between all allies (rounded down)

**(3) Snom Bunny, Unit, Human, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #25**
5/5
**Can’t be in defense position**
**Death:** A random enemy **Permanent** comes under your control
~~~
10/10
**Lucky 1**
**Death:** A random enemy **Permanent** comes under your control

**(1) Soul Read, Trap, Common, Stinkyscape+, #31**
**Cry:** Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card secretly.
Reveals if your opponent plays the chosen card before any of the other cards you saw. Take control of that card instead. Otherwise, Tribute this Trap.
~~~
**Cry:** Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card secretly.
Reveals if your opponent plays the chosen card. Take control of that card instead.

**(3) Bogos Binted, Unit, Legendary,** **Stinkyscape+, #84**
5/6
**Cry:** Take a snapshot of all your other permanents.
**Death**: Reset your board to that state.
~~~
10/12
**Cry:** Take a snapshot of all your other permanents.
**Death**: Reset your board to that state but they’re Radiant.

**(2) Doomed Ship, Spell, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #98**
Add a **Kwzki** and **Shockwave447**, **Shadiris** and **xxFreshJack**, or **Tylannt** and **Siva 1** to the left and right most cards of your hand. When they meet both become Radiant.
~~~
Add a **Kwzki** and **Shockwave447**, **Shadiris** and **xxFreshJack**, or **Tylannt** and **Siva 1** to the left and right most cards of your hand. When they meet both become Radiant and cost (0).
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3558

Part of #3534.
````

# Draft plan #3567 (S19: Profe Yates, Churnwalker, Snom Bunny, Soul Read, Bogos Binted, Doomed Ship)

## Found so far
- Base ed1de035ba = bot/issue-3596 tip; holds F (#3535), E6 (#3550), E7 (#3554, folded in #3560's commit). E8 (#3558) is
  built on origin/bot/issue-3558 (0a8f553f50) but NOT landed ("parked for #3596"). Doomed Ship needs E8's
  `effects::add_meeting_pair(AddMeetingPairArgs{left,right,player,radiant,meet_cost})` (add_to_hand.rs), hand_order.rs,
  R3558002. Fixture shape: e8 `ship()` in tests/rules/fixtures/hand_deck_fuse.rs (cry hook on a Spell).
- E6 fixture shapes (copy): crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/combat_reactions.rs bogos(), soul_read(), bunny().
- E7: chain_units({side:"enemy"|"self", kind:"shared"|"split"}).
- Modes at play + remember + Activate `has` gate: stinkyscape/c026_zolarketh.rs (exact pattern for Yates).
- "Activate N" = N uses a turn (§6.2 row, R384), NOT mana. Yates: Overwhelm 1, Wolf's Maw 3, Iron Mandate 1; uses are
  script constants (Sei c124 precedent), params overwhelm/wolf/iron stay as printed; damage via param("damage").
- No verb exiles by name -> new `exile_named` in effects/move_.rs (reuse exile_board's field walk + EXILE_ZONE_ORDER).
- No verb removes a keyword -> new `lose_keyword` in effects/tune.rs reusing private `remove_kind` (tuning; kept through zones).
- Targets: TargetFilter has no keyword field -> `check` + Script.target_checks (stinkyscape/c012_2...). FilterSide: ally/enemy/any.
- fuse: fuse_cards({instanceIds:[yates], targetInstanceId}) ; fused Cries never run (R77); kept memory is target's.
- remember() keys get rerooted as KEY@path when a card is fused INTO Yates -> has-hook must accept KEY or KEY@*.
- Snom Bunny: "Can't be in Defense Position" = keyword Can't Defend (R2657000), add to catalog base. Radiant Lucky 1 ->
  luck roll (Fortify Flesh c145 shape: lucky_on + luck_of; better = higher effective_cost).
- Doomed Ship catalog bug: "Shockwave{shadiris}"/"Siva {to}" params -> literal text, drop params, refs add -087,-110,-111,
  "Kwzki"->"iKwzki". params.rs FIXED already has ("stinkyscapeplus-098", PRICE). refs test = references.rs r279.
- No S+ rows in card-text.yaml / card-audio / fx / radiant-audit (S26's). §8.12 rows appended at end of spec/08-catalog.md.
- AI redaction: opponent face-down trap -> placeholder (memory cleared), so Soul Read pick never reaches the other AI.
- Fixture index range free: 35670-35679 (ids `s19-`). Engine test file crates/engine/tests/rules/stinkyscape_plus_s19.rs in mod_3.rs.

## Rulings (R3567000..)
0 exile_named reading; 1 two/three random traps; 2 chosen Activate as play mode + has + Iron Mandate; 3 Overwhelm scope;
4 Wolf's Maw lose Flying (+damage); 5 Snom Bunny Lucky on pick; 6 Doomed Ship pair pick + text.
